Good one
Dec 2025 • Friends
We stopped by Soho Rooftop Bar for drinks and had a pleasant evening. The rooftop has a modern, stylish feel with nice views over the city, especially after dark. Cocktails were well made and nicely presented, with prices in line for a central rooftop bar. The atmosphere was lively but comfortable, and service was friendly and efficient. A good option for evening drinks in Hanoi.
